tess: Heads-up: hit a subtle streaming + jsonMode bug in the TS SDK when using function-calls. The stream breaks a single JSON arguments object across chunks and our streaming parser tries to parse each chunk independently. Result: handler gets a parse error or a partial arg object.

maya: Oof. Which sample-app and SDK version? Can you paste a tiny trace?

tess: sample-kit/streaming-quickstart, TS SDK 0.13.2, run with JSON_MODE=1. Repro: stream a function_call where arguments is an object (or array) that gets large enough to be chunked. The SDK's stream parser emits events like: `data: {"function_call": {"name":"extract","arguments":"{"text":"Acm` then next chunk `e","id":123}}` so the arguments string becomes invalid JSON when parsed separately. Validator throws `Unexpected end of JSON input`.

samir: Is the SDK using line-delimited JSON or framed boundaries? We had an async parser that tried to parse per data event rather than accumulating.

rahul: Looks like a regression from the streaming refactor. Previously we buffered until we could parse a full top-level JSON object. The new code attempts to JSON.parse on each event to be low-latency. That fails for chunked objects.

maya: Quick mitigation: SDK should accumulate until parse succeeds or a max buffer size; also safe to use newline-delimited JSON from the service side. For sample-kit note: use smaller payloads or disable jsonMode for streaming demos.

qa-bot: New issue created: DEVEX-911 "ts-sdk: streaming parser tries to parse partial chunks in jsonMode" (labels: bug, streaming, test-needed).

tess: I added a tiny shim in the sample app to reassemble `data` chunks into a buffer and only parse when buffer contains balanced braces (quick heuristic). It unblocks onboarding but it's hacky.

samir: For the SDK fix: implement a simple incremental parser that appends chunks and attempts parse; if parse fails due to EOF keep buffering, but if it fails for other reasons surface error. Add unit tests that simulate split-chunk positions (start, middle, end) and assert parsed arguments are identical to original.

rahul: Agree. Also add an e2e in sample-kit: run stream with artificially tiny chunk sizes and ensure handler receives complete args. That will catch regressions in streaming refactors.

maya: One more thought: the SDK should provide a `streamingMode` option that can be `framed` (server emits length prefix), `ndjson`, or `json-buffered` (our default). Document tradeoffs in the onboarding guide so folks know which to pick for low-latency vs correctness.

tess: Thanks all. I'll drop the sample-kit shim PR and link DEVEX-911. Leaving the issue blocked on the SDK patch + sample-kit e2e.
